title: Rebar Material
description: Detailed schema for rebar material settings used by GIRDER_REBAR_PROP and SLAB_REBAR_PROP in Modify Material.

CODE.description: Rebar design code. If CODE is 'None', input custom rebar names, Fy and Fys directly instead of selecting GRADE_MAIN_REBAR and GRADE_SUB_REBAR.

GRADE_MAIN_REBAR.description: Grade of main rebar. Required when CODE is not 'None'.

GRADE_SUB_REBAR.description: Grade of sub-rebar. Required when CODE is not 'None'.

NAME_MAIN_REBAR.description: User-defined main rebar name. Required when CODE is 'None'.

NAME_SUB_REBAR.description: User-defined sub-rebar name. Required when CODE is 'None'.

Fy.description: Yield strength of main rebar. User input is available when CODE is 'None'.

Fys.description: Yield strength of sub-rebar. User input is available when CODE is 'None'.
